seed_prompts.solve: Solve the supplied task. Follow its output_contract exactly. Return your final answer clearly.
seed_prompts.reason: Work through the task carefully and check the reasoning. Follow the task output_contract exactly.
seed_prompts.review: Review the upstream solution, correct errors and independently verify the result. Follow the task output_contract exactly.
seed_prompts.merge: Compare the independent upstream solutions and verify their claims. Produce a single final answer following the task output_contract.

evaluation.note: Complete 500-task held-out terminal evaluation; independent explicit invocation only.

notes: User authorized 30-round staged experiment on 2026-09-21 with local Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ and DeepSeek Flash only; no Pro or middle API calls.

Primary cost objective is external API spend. Local capacity is excluded from monetary cost by explicit user choice; local inference seconds remain observable. This is not a total operating cost comparison.
Keep cost_scale_usd and router/exploration settings unchanged; record the changed cost objective explicitly instead of tuning for favorable results.
Freeze 70 development and 280 calibration tasks; exclude held-out evaluation from checkpoint continuation decisions.
Stop after round 30 with checkpoint. No automatic extension, test evaluation, retries, or reuse of the old six-round learning state.
API costs use returned token usage and frozen provider tariffs, not verified invoices. Search generation fees count in total API spend.
Quality/cost transformations, snapshot-HV curvature and allocation remain engineering choices without transferred theoretical guarantees.
